windows: All existing genuine windows, original masks; about -29 to +29 s centers; no subsampling, no newly extracted data
raw_preprocess: Per valid window: channel-local mean subtraction / population SD floor1e-6, clip[-8,8], same for all eight; not cross-channel PR
aggregation: Window embedding mean within each available seizure/channel, then available-seizure mean and population SD, feature-major interleaved; differentiable. Matches Raw-ABS aggregation contract. No temporal DELTA/pre-reference subtraction or engineered features.
PR: After final channel aggregation and before the same classifier: float64 channel mean/population SD; denominator=SD if SD>1e-8 else1; masked invalid channels excluded. No additive epsilon replacement.
initialization: scratch; fold seed42+1009*fold; exact same complete initial state for Original and PR; no pretrained encoder or D1 scores
loss: FIT-only NEZ-positive BCE, one complete patient mean/update; target encodedNEZ internally, EZ-positive reporting
selection: Validation patient mean Macro-F1, EZ-F1, earlier epoch; no Outer-dependent choice
threshold: Validation EZ-probability grid0:0.005:1, maximum patient Macro-F1 then EZ-F1 then nearest0.5 then lower threshold; shared with preceding feature baseline (no forbidden auxiliary metric)
amp: Training CUDA bfloat16 backbone/classifier, float32 reductions, float64 PR. Validation/test strictlyFP32; disableTF32, retaincuDNN. Pretraining outcome-free probe rejectedBF16 inference due0.0272 chunk-score drift versus6.32e-6 inFP32. No GradScaler required forBF16.
memory: Exact two-pass patient gradient cache: all windows first; full-channel aggregation/PR/head; replay each deterministic chunk with RNG state and restore encoder BN buffers. No truncated gradient or mini-channel PR.
search: One fixed setting per backbone, same budget/config for paired versions; no additional seeds/models
outer: Freeze all ten selected cells for a backbone before its single Outer pass; seal scores before new full label access; no later tuning of any backbone
reference_comparability: Same cohort/folds/targets/patient metrics. M8 also has physiological DELTA, guided stage-specific Raw correction and different objective; not a strict architecture-only same-input comparison. Raw baselines share ABS-style full-window aggregation.
publish: Only source, hashes and anonymous aggregate results; weights, IDs, labels, latent embeddings, patient/channel predictions and logs remain trusted-server-only
